channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: Canada Rags On America At Globalist Meetup After Shaking Hands With China
item.description: Speaking before the World Economic Forum in Davos on Tuesday, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney claimed the global order is experiencing a "rupture" following continuing pressure from President Donald Trump U.S. control over Greenland.

item.title: Usha Vance Is Pregnant With Fourth Child
item.description: Vice President J.D. Vance's office announced on Tuesday that second lady Usha Vance is pregnant with her fourth child, making her the first second lady to have a child while her husband was in office.

item.title: ‘We’ve Been Given Marching Orders’: Congressman Urges UFO Disclosures, Whistleblower Protection
item.description: Republican Missouri Rep. Eric Burlison joined witnesses and enthusiasts at a conference commemorating the 30th anniversary of a famous alleged extraterrestrial encounter, during which he spoke in favor of disclosure and whistleblower protection.

item.title: Journalists Lose Their Minds When Border Agent Tells Minnesotans To Stop Clogging 911 System
item.description: Journalists erupted when Chief Border Patrol Agent Greg Bovino told the public not to flood the 911 system with calls about immigration officers in Minnesota at a Tuesday press conference.

item.title: Trump Facing Warning Signs One Year In Amid ‘Growing Economic Pessimism,’ Analysts Say
item.description: President Donald Trump is facing warning signs a year into his second term as some recent polls have shown many Americans growing increasingly concerned about his economy.

item.title: War Department Breaks Down Just How Much Money Biden Admin Telework Policy Wasted
item.description: The Department of War Office of Inspector General (OIG) issued a report on the Biden administration-era telework policies Tuesday that revealed that at least $665,000 was spent — questionably — on locality pay.

item.title: Federal Judges Take Over Hiring For Key DOJ Spot After Disqualifying Trump Attorney
item.description: Federal judges posted a job application online Tuesday seeking someone to take Lindsey Halligan's place as U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of Virginia.

item.title: Air Force One Makes U-Turn Over Atlantic, Returns To Andrews AFB
item.description: Air Force One turned around while en route to the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland Tuesday night.

item.title: JASON SNEAD: Minnesota’s ‘Vouching’ Disaster Proves America Needs SAVE Act
item.description: Minnesota’s election system stands as one of the worst in the nation, and its “vouching” policy is a prime example of why confidence in election security remains fragile.

item.title: ‘I Have Very Firm Instructions’: Trump Makes Clear What Happens To Iran If He’s Assassinated
item.description: In an interview broadcast Tuesday night, President Donald Trump told NewsNation host Katie Pavlich that he left instructions to wipe Iran “off the face of this earth” if he's assassinated.
